newsitem.title: UK: PSION BOUNCES ON DEMAND FOR NEW PALMTOP.
newsitem.headline: PSION BOUNCES ON DEMAND FOR NEW PALMTOP.

text.p: Shares in hand-held computer company Psion Plc rebounded from recent weakness on Monday after a press report highlighted the strong demand for the company's new Series 5 computer.
The shares rose 21p or 7.4 percent to 305p in trade of 358,000 by 1040 GMT.

The Times newspaper said that Psion was failing to meet higher-than-expected demand for its latest Series 5 portable computer. The report also said sales of Psion's earlier palmtop model were suffering as customers waited for the new version.

But the shares rallied, taking only the positive news of strong demand on board. The company had said back in June it would take time for production to reach full speed and analysts were expecting sales of the older model to drop off.
"There are some good buyers around today," said one trader. "People have noted the positive news and the fact that the new product is very good, and the negative news was already known."
Shares in Psion have underperformed the All-Share index by 44 percent since the beginning of June, when the company warned of the slowdown in sales.
The stock fell from a peak of 509p on June 12 to a low of 298p on August 1 and was due a rebound, traders said.
